compartment.definition: Area of the cilium (also called flagellum) where the basal body and the axoneme are anchored to the plasma membrane. The ciliary base encompasses the distal part of the basal body, transition fibers and transition zone and is structurally and functionally very distinct from the rest of the cilium. In this area proteins are sorted and filtered before entering the cilium, and many ciliary proteins localize specifically to this area.

summation.displayName: Phosphorylation of GLI3 by PKA on up to six sites in the C-t...
summation.text: Phosphorylation of GLI3 by PKA on up to six sites in the C-terminal region primes the protein for subsequent phosphorylation by CK1 and GSK3 and is required for the ubiquitin-mediated processing by the proteasome to yield the truncated repressor form (Tempe et al, 2006; Pan et al, 2006; Pan and Wang, 2007; Wang and Li, 2006).  Processing of GLI3 is regulated in part by movement through the primary cilia, and disruption of intraflagellar transport abrogates processing (Wen et al, 2010)
